name: kite
description: Agentic design in Kite: Codex designs app screens, user flows, landing pages and design systems, plus banners, posts and logos, in a file your team edits and comments on.

interface.longDescription: Kite is an agentic design tool: people and their agents design in the same file, at the same time. With this plugin, Codex designs real, editable work on a canvas your team opens, edits and comments on: app screens and user flows, landing pages, design systems and components, and banners, social posts, ads and logos. It follows your design system's tokens and components, reads comments and applies them, and hands back a link.
capabilities: Design app screens and user flows
Show and edit files in the chat
defaultPrompt: Design a three-screen onboarding flow for my app in Kite
Show my Product launch file here in the chat
Read the comments on my Kite file and apply them

positive.description: Show a file in the chat and edit it there
positive.prompt: Show me my Product launch design here in the chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Product launch file as a card in the chat: its picture, its name, Open in Kite and Edit here. Edit here opens the Kite editor full screen inside ChatGPT, signed in to the same account, where the design can be edited directly.

positive.prompt: Design a three-screen onboarding flow for a meditation app in Kite and show it to me here.
positive.tools_triggered: file_new, guide_read, layer_draw, layer_render, file_open, finish_working
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new Kite file, draws three phone screens as editable layers (text as text, shapes as frames), checks each with a rendered preview, and shows the file in the chat as a card that opens the editor.

positive.prompt: Design a 1080x1080 Instagram post in Kite announcing our summer sale, and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new Kite design file with one 1080×1080 frame announcing the summer sale, checks it with a rendered preview, and returns the file's kite.new link.

positive.prompt: In my product launch file, make the headline on the hero banner bigger and change it to the brand's primary colour.
positive.expected_behavior: Edits only the headline layer (size and colour from the file's design-system token), shows a preview, and leaves the rest of the design as it was.

positive.prompt: Read the comments on my product launch file and apply them.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the file's comments, makes the requested changes to the layers they point at, and replies to each comment saying what changed.

negative.expected_behavior: Does not act: Kite's tools cannot delete an account. Explains that the account can be deleted in Kite's settings.

negative.prompt: Buy me a paid Kite plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not act: the plugin makes and edits design files and cannot buy plans or take payments. Points the user to kite.new.

negative.prompt: Open the private Kite files of another person that were never shared with me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not act: Kite only reaches files in the signed-in account or shared with it, and says so.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Kite in the chat: a file your agent makes or shows appears as a card with its picture, and Edit here opens the full Kite editor inside ChatGPT. Also 61 tools for agentic UI, UX and product design: pages, versions, components and slots, design systems, icons, web capture and export as HTML, React or Tailwind.
